create_multi_optim: create a MultiOptim instance holding multiple PyTorch optimizers as an OrderedDict
step_multi_optim: call step on all optimizers stored in the MultiOptim dict at once
zero_grad_multi_optim: zero gradients across all optimizers managed by the MultiOptim instance
lr_multiply_multi_optim: multiply all optimizer learning rates by a given factor relative to base_lr
state_dict_multi_optim: save or load the combined state dict of all optimizers in MultiOptim
